divergences.upstreamResult: React maps text editing through its synthetic onChange event layer.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane uses the native input event for per-keystroke DOM wiring while preserving public value callbacks.
divergences.rationale: Octane does not emulate React's synthetic event layer.
divergences.consumerImpact: Native text host handlers use onInput; library value callbacks keep their documented names.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use onInput for raw text host edits and keep React Aria value callbacks unchanged.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane introduces a synthetic change-event compatibility layer.

divergences.upstreamResult: React component refs are exposed through forwardRef wrappers.
divergences.octaneResult: Refs arrive as ordinary component props and are forwarded to the authored host node.
divergences.rationale: Octane follows a compiler-visible ref-as-prop contract.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers pass ref normally, but React forwardRef component identity is not reproduced.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Declare and forward the ref prop directly in Octane components.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adopts React forwardRef compatibility.

divergences.upstreamResult: The pinned serializer derives identifiers from character codes and emits invalid JavaScript after 26 common strings.
divergences.octaneResult: The serializer uses a-z followed by valid underscore-number identifiers.
divergences.rationale: Server bootstrap output must remain executable for every dictionary size.
divergences.consumerImpact: Large localized dictionaries produce valid inline bootstrap scripts.
divergences.migrationGuidance: No migration is required; do not rely on invalid upstream output.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream changes its hoisted-string identifier algorithm.

divergences.upstreamResult: The pinned SSR branch returns ltr even when the injected locale is RTL.
divergences.octaneResult: SSR direction is derived from the injected locale through isRTL.
divergences.rationale: The returned direction must agree with the locale used by the same server snapshot.
divergences.consumerImpact: RTL server markup receives the correct direction before hydration.
divergences.migrationGuidance: No migration is required; consume the locale direction returned by the provider.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream fixes its SSR locale direction.
